text:
We all are grown up now, and at some point, we need to start thinking about ourselves too.  
Because the truth is — if you don’t speak for yourself, no one else will fully do it for you.  

Take your decisions.  
Have open conversations.  
Say what you truly feel.  

Because at the end of the day, if something hurts you, you are the one who has to carry that pain.  

So take a stand for yourself.  
Your feelings matter too. ❤️
